{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out QC-failed baseline values
valid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df[valid_baseline].sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Step 3: Compute mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker (ng/mL): {mean_baseline:.2f}")"}
